title: Review decisions (payload from the review screen to the semantic detection module)
description: Status: PROPOSED, not approved. What the user decided on the single review screen. The module takes the same values as function arguments: target -> overrides, problem_type -> problem_type_override, approved_feature_columns -> approved_feature_columns, goal -> goal. Pending: Team 2 (how the backend passes it) and Team 3 (screen).

dataset_id.description: Key of the dataset (same as in the profiling output)

goal.description: Optional business goal in plain words

target.description: Target column chosen by the user. Null = no choice made yet

problem_type.description: Problem type confirmed by the user. Null = not confirmed yet (needs_confirmation stays true)

approved_feature_columns.description: Feature columns the user approved. Null = not approved yet (features_status stays recommended_pending_confirmation). Sensitive columns are used only if listed here
